item.title: Jamaica Secures Highest Ever Vote in Re-Election to IMO Council
item.description: Jamaica has been re-elected to Category C of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) Council, securing 129 votes, the highest number the country has ever received in an IMO Council election. item.title: C5 Spikes to Year-High, Matching 4Q23 Peak
item.description: C5 assessments have climbed back to the peak levels last seen in 4Q23, the highest in nearly a year. The momentum from October carried straight into November. item.title: Unlocking ammonia as a fuel source for heavy industry
item.description: At a high level, ammonia seems like a dream fuel: It’s carbon-free, energy-dense, and easier to move and store than hydrogen.
